title: Operational challenges with many companies per environment

facts.text: Since 2023 release wave 1, maximum company limit per environment is enforced to prevent operational challenges.
Admin operations on environments are blocked if company count exceeds the defined maximum limit.
Each environment shares one compute cluster and database, so resource management like throttling and load balancing occurs at environment level.
Data exports use BACPAC format which cannot handle excessive database tables; each company has roughly 1800 tables.
Service notifications, upgrades, user access configuration, and extension deployment apply to entire environment, not individual companies.
Point-in-time restore (PITR) restores whole environment, not individual companies, increasing recovery time with many companies.
Integrate Business Central with services like Dynamics 365 Sales and Dataverse becomes more complex with many companies.
